notes.title: 🎉 Version 1.0 Official Release丨 Massive New Content Arrives!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After months of hard work, we're proud to present the official release of "Pinball Storm: Lokanta"! This 1.0 update brings not only extensive optimizations and fixes, but also a complete gameplay system overhaul and brand-new content for you to experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44958646/eb2e829d605546e1493709688e9cfdea0521b220.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]🔮 New Pinballs & Adhisthanas[/h2]
Five distinctive new Adhisthanas and three unique Pinballs have arrived! From high-speed mobility to last-stand bursts, from precision strikes to area control - strategic diversity has been elevated! Customize your combat rhythm and develop your own tactical system to make every battle unique!

[h3]【New Pinballs】[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fleeting Dust Pinball - Targets groups of enemies, launching countless pinballs
[*] Canopy Shield Pinball - Creates a defensive zone with infinite ricochets
[*] Victorious Banner Pinball - The ultimate trickster pinball with teleportation effects
[/list]
[h3]【New Adhisthanas】[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rapidity - Damage increases with movement speed
[*] Furious Heart - Damage increases as HP decreases
[*] Heart Chain - Transforms pinballs into yo-yo weapons
[*] Adjunct - AI-assisted auto-aiming
[*] Worship - Damage increases with each enemy defeated
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]♾️ Endless Mode Major Upgrade![/h2]

The Endless Mode has been completely redesigned for deeper strategy and progression:

【Revolutionary Starting System】- New independent reward system with initial choices:

◆ Multiple prize item combinations
◆ Several future Adhisthana enhancements
◆ Pinball base level upgrades

【Dynamic Difficulty Selection】- Replaced fixed difficulty progression with:

◆ 5-tier gradient selection (Basic/Elite/Nightmare/Abyss/Chaos)
◆ Tiered unlock system (clear current difficulty to unlock next)
◆ 35% reward increase per difficulty tier

【Mode Structure Optimization】- 30 stages as benchmark completion point:
◆ Option to exit and immediately retry with stage rewards
◆ Or continue into "True·Endless Mode"

【True·Endless Mode】
◆ New enemy patterns without weaker foes
◆ Still provides periodic rewards

The goal of this update is to improve both strategic depth and replay value. Players can experiment with different tactical builds through customizable starting configurations and self-selected challenge levels. True Endless Mode serves as the ultimate proving ground for hardcore players.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]📊 Balance Adjustments[/h2]

Pinballs now always rebound instead of disappearing when leaving bounds. All pinballs' Reload Time has been reduced uniformly - no longer requiring upgrades to decrease.
[list]
[*] Trailokya Beads: Reload Time 2.5s→1.5s
[*] Five Ways Pinball: Reload Time 2s→1.2s
[*] Conch Pinball: Reload Time 2.5s→1.5s
[*] Vajra Chakra Pinball: Reload Time 5s→2.5s
[/list]
Each pinball's Collision Count has been adjusted according to characteristics and can be upgraded through the pinball system. Additional Adhisthana adjustments:
[list]
[*] Balanced effects across Agate Adhisthana system
[*] Fixed effect bug in Dharmachakra's ultimate weapon - explosion probability now more noticeable
[*] Sea Shell Adhisthana: Original Cold Realm effect rarity upgraded to red, original True Sea Shell downgraded to blue
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]🔧 Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Story Mode 2.0 update: Shortened some stages and redesigned enemy stats/spawn logic for better pacing
[*] Fixed abnormal prize effects
[*] Fixed Prize Gacha Machine upgrades not saving properly
[*] Corrected descriptions for certain pinballs
[*] Fixed achievement synchronization issues with Steam under specific conditions
[*] Resolved duplicate unlock messages
[*] Fixed incorrect minion HP values
[*] Addressed Adhisthana unloading issues
[*] Improved inventory organization for equipped prizes
[*] Optimized Index UI panel
[*] Enhanced inventory usability
[*] Fixed combat result display errors in certain scenarios
[*] Added confirmation prompt when starting new game with existing save
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642570/_/

notes.title: V0.8.3 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you all for your valuable feedback. We’ve been working tirelessly to make adjustments and improvements to better meet your expectations! If you encounter any issues during gameplay, please join our community to communicate directly with me. This way, I can understand and address your concerns more quickly and effectively.

[h1]Fixes & Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where characters could not level up under certain conditions.
[*] Resolved a problem where some achievements failed to sync with Steam in specific scenarios.
[*] Updated dialogue sound effects and fixed the issue where the volume could not be adjusted.
[*] Optimized and resolved several UI issues, including duplicate content on the pinball selection page, label overlaps, text overflow, and notifications for insufficient tokens to draw gacha.
[*] Set a maximum frame rate of 120 FPS.
[/list]
Thank you once again for your support! If you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a positive review on Steam—it means a lot to indie developers.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update Content Preview! Get the First Look at More Surprises!
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers from Fengtu!

Thanks everyone for your support to Pinball Storm: Lokanta! After the release of the game demo, we have received many valuable suggestions and feedback. Your active playtesting and feedback give me the opportunity to continuously improve and enhance the gaming experience.

Pinball Storm: Lokanta will continue to add more new content, including levels, enemies, bosses, marbles, etc., and there will also be more tasks, mechanisms, props, and characters!

In addition, an endless mode will be added for those who need a limitless bouncing experience!

I believe that future updates will bring more surprises to players! At the same time, I sincerely invite everyone to add our game to your Steam Wishlist! Indie game development is a long and hard way to go, and player support will always fuel us to the end of the road!

We also invite everyone to join our Discord at: https://discord.gg/CGyfedBhed to communicate with us directly!

notes.title: Pinball Storm: Lokanta Early Access V0.1.11 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi, adventurers to Fengtu!
Thanks everyone for your dedicated support to our Early Access game. We have received many feedbacks from our players. Based on that, we had made a series of changes and fixes to the game. If you have any ideas or suggestions to our game, please join our official Discord at [url=https://discord.gg/UBwYfSCRqn]https://discord.gg/UBwYfSCRqn[/url] to directly tell us!

You can also fill in our game experience survey at: [[url=https://forms.gle/XJvNxwg73uCSQzQE6]https://forms.gle/XJvNxwg73uCSQzQE6[/url]]. Please share your comment with us. Your opinion on the game is most precious to us. Thank you so much for all your support to Pinball Storm: Lokanta!

Here are the fixes/changes we made over the week:
[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased base movement speed
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue that in adhisthana stone tablet dialogue, you cannot select your adhisthana.
[*] Fixed the Boss would randomly stucked
[*] Fixed the issue where adhisthana details could not be viewed normally in the in-game pause menu
[*] Fixed the issue where the mouse hovering menu in the game was blocked
[*] Fixed the problem of tutorial cannot be finished in some cases
[*] Fixed the issue where the [Next Level] button was not interactive in some cases
[*] Fixed the problem that the save could not preserve your upgrade data
[/list]
